chunks: Ibn Mahboub, from Abu Ayoub Al-Khazzaz, from Ibn Muskan, from Al-Halby, who said:

I asked Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him) about the man who is breastfed by a woman while he is a boy, is it permissible for him to marry her sister from the mother via breastfeeding? He (peace be upon him) said: If the two women were breastfed by one woman from the milk of one stallion (father), then it is not permissible; and if the two women were breastfed by one woman from the milk of two stallions (fathers), then there is no problem with that.

key_terms.فَلَا بَأْسَ: There is no problem / It is permissible

ai.seo_question: What is the condition for milk sisters to be prohibited from marrying each other in Shia jurisprudence?
ai.summary: This hadith from al-Kafi elucidates the specific condition of 'radāʿ al-fahl' (milk from a male) in Shia jurisprudence, distinguishing it from the more common maternal nursing. It establishes that for milk kinship to create a marriage prohibition, the milk must originate from the same male source; if the milk comes from different stallions, the prohibition is lifted, highlighting the precision of Shia legal reasoning in distinguishing between maternal and paternal milk sources.

en.hubeali: Ibn Mahboub, from Abu Ayoub Al Khazzaz, from Ibn Muskan, from Al halby who said,

‘I asked Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> about the man who is breast-fed from a woman and he was a boy, is it Permissible for him that he marries her sister of her mother from the breast-feeding?’ So he<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘If it was such that the two women were both breast-fed from one woman from the milk of one stallion (father), so it is not Permissible; and if it was two women who had both been breast-fed from one woman from the milk of two stallions (fathers), so there is no problem with that’.
en.sarwar: 11. Ibn Mahbub has narrated from abu Ayyub al-Khazzaz from ibn Muskan from al-Halabiy who has said the following: “This is concerning my question before abu ‘Abd Allah, ‘Alayhi al-Salam, about the case of a man who is breastfed when a child by a woman; if it is lawful for him to marry her sister because of breastfeeding from her mother’s side.

He (the Imam) said, ‘If the two women are breastfed by one woman from the milk of one “impregnating agent” (husband), then it is unlawful but if the two women are breastfed by one woman with milk of two “impregnating agents” (husbands), then it is not unlawful.’”
